info.title: Avari.Jobs API
info.description: Website mutations require a CSRF header with the avari_csrf cookie value. Extension sessions use Bearer tokens. Only /me and /auth/logout are accessible to pending/blocked accounts. The calendar feed uses a separate secret read-only token and is only available for active accounts. Changes require user confirmation. There is no administrative HTTP API.
